baselineDisplay.title: 难懂的方言
baselineDisplay.text:
【故事复现】难懂的方言（上）
• Step 1: Listen and answer the question.
第一步：听 Freya 慢速朗读的故事，回答下列问题。
Question: Why does the writer not understand the porter?
问题：为什么作者理解不了这个搬运工说的话？
Answer: Because the porter doesn’t speak English like the writer’s teacher.
• 词汇准备
• railway 铁路
• porter 搬运工
• several 几个
• foreigner 外国人
• wonder 感到奇怪
• Step 2: Intensive reading.
第二步：故事精读。
I arrived in London at last. The railway station was big, black and dark.
我终于到了伦敦。火车站很大，又黑又暗。
I did not know the way to my hotel, so I asked a porter. I not only spoke English very carefully, but very clearly as well.
我不知道去酒店的路该怎么走，于是向一个搬运工打听。我的英语讲得不但非常认真，而且咬字也非常清楚。
The porter, however, could not understand me. I repeated my question several times and at last he understood.
然而搬运工却不明白我的话。我把问题重复了很多遍。他终于听懂了。
He answered me, but he spoke neither slowly nor clearly. ‘I am a foreigner,’ I said.
他回答了，但他讲得既不慢也不清楚。“我是个外国人，”我说。
Then he spoke slowly, but I could not understand him. My teacher never spoke English like that!
于是他说得慢了，可我还是听不懂。我的老师从来不那样讲英语!
The porter and I looked at each other and smiled. Then he said something and I understood it.
我和搬运工相视一笑。接着，他说了点什么，这回我听懂了。
‘You’ll soon learn English!’ he said. I wonder.
“您会很快学会英语的!”他说。我感到奇怪。
In England, each person speaks a different language. The English understand each other, but I don’t understand them! Do they speak English?
在英国，人们各自说着一种不同的语言。英国人之间相互听得懂，可我却不懂他们的话!他们说的是英语吗?
第二十二单元 【故事复现】难懂的方言（下）
• Step 3: Listen again and answer the questions.
第三步：再听一遍，回答下列问题。
1 Did you arrive at a railway station in London or not? Did you ask a porter the way to your hotel or not? Could he understand you or not? (and... but)
2 Did he understand you at last or not? Could you understand his answer? (but)
3 Did your teacher ever speak English like that or not?
4 What did the porter say to you?
5 Does each person speak different language in England or not?
6 Do they understand each other or not? Do you understand them? (but)
Answer: I arrived at a railway station in London and asked a porter the way to my hotel, but he could not understand me. He understood me at last, but I could not understand his answer. My teacher never spoke English like that. The porter said that I would soon learn English. Each man speaks a different language in England. They understand each other, but I do not understand them.
• Exercise: Sentence structure and vocabulary.
课外练习：句型及词汇训练。
I Why couldn't the writer understand the porter?
(a) The writer didn't know any English.
(b) The porter didn't speak English.
(c) The writer couldn't understand the porter's English
(d) The writer was foreigner.
2 The writer ______.
(a) didn't think the porter was English
(b) expected everyone in England to speak like his teach
(c) doesn't think the English speak English
(d) thinks that the English speak many different languages
3 English _____ not difficult language.
(a) are
(b) is
(c) was
(d) has
4 ______ did you repeat your question? Several times.
(a) How many times
(b) How many
(c) How much
(d) How
5 He didn't speak slowly and he didn't speak clearly ______.
(a) neither
(b) either
(c) too
(d) nor
6 The porter and I looked at each other. _____ both smiled.
(a) I
(b) He
(c) We
(d) They
7 He said something and I understood it. He said something _____ I understood.
(a) who
(b) whose
(c) whom
(d) which
8 I repeated my question several times. I repeated it _____ times.
(a) much
(b) a number of
(c) only a few
(d) three
9 At last he understood. He understood ______.
(a) in the end
(b) at least
(c) lastly
(d) at the finish
10 I come from abroad. I am ________.
(a) a foreigner
(b) strange
(c) overseas
(d) abroad
11 My teacher _______ me English.
(a) learnt
(b) trained
(c) instructed
(d) taught
12 'You'll soon learn English,' he said. I wonder. I _______.
(a) am not sure
(b) am sure
(c) wander
(d) know
Key: 1 c 2 b 3 b 4 a 5 b 6 c 7 d 8 b 9 a 10 a 11 d 12 a
第二十二单元 语法点拨 常用介词的用法（下）
▶ 表示目的、对象的介词：
表示目的、对象的介词有：for, to, at, on, for the purpose of, for the sake of, on behalf of, in honor of, with a view to.
• for 表示拟定的接收人或目的；to 表示实际的接收人或目的。
▪ I brought the gift for my little sister. 我为我的小妹妹带来了礼物。
▪ I gave the gift to my little sister. 我把礼物给了我的小妹妹。
▪ for 和 to 都可以引导目的地。for 跟在含有出发或开始意义的动词后，如: leave, set out, start, depart, sail 等；to 跟在含有来往行动意义的动词后,如: go, come, run, walk, move, fly, drive, ride 等。
• They have left for Hong Kong. 他们已经离开去香港。
• He flew to America via Hong Kong. 他途经香港去了美国。
▶ 表示条件的介词:
表示条件的介词有: but for, except for, in case of, in the event of, without 等。
• But for the rain we would have had a nice holiday.
要不是因为下雨，我们的假日一定过得很惬意。
• The doctor asked us to call him during the night except in case of necessity.
医生吩咐我们，除非必须，否则不要在夜里叫他。
• In the event of rain, the party will be held indoors.
万一下雨，聚会就在室内举行。
• She has enjoyed perfect health, except for an occasional cold.
除了偶尔感冒外，她的健康状况非常好。
▶ 表示结果的介词:
表示结果的介词有：into, to 等。
• Intense cold turns water into ice. 酷冷把水变成了冰。
• The town came to life after sunrise. 日出之后，这个市镇变得充满生气。
▶ 表示对比的介词:
表示对比的介词有: against, beside, to, in comparison with, in contrast to/with 等。
• A majority of 10 against 3 十比三的多数
• The pine trees were black against the morning sky.
在早晨天空的映照下，那些松树呈黑色。
• The score was 9 to 5. 得分是九比五。
• You’re quite tall beside your brother. 与你兄弟相比，你是相当高的。
• In contrast with their system, ours seems very old-fashioned.
我们的制度与他们的相比，显得过于守旧了。
▶ 表示方式、方法、手段的介词:
表示方式、方法和手段的介词有: after, by, in, on, like, through, with, without, by means of 等。after 表示模仿；by 表示途径或手段；in 表示方式；on 表示工具；through 表示途径、手段，与 by 的意义接近；with 表示工具、抽象方式。
• She was named after her grandmother. 她以她祖母的名字为名。
• She makes living by writing. 她靠写作谋生。
• The boy goes to school by bus. 这男孩乘公共汽车去上学。(不用冠词)
• The quickest means of travel is by plane.
最快的旅行途径是乘飞机。(不用冠词)
• He arrived at the airport in a brand-new car.
他乘坐一辆崭新的小车到达机场。(不可用 by)
• We will go there on launch. 我们将乘汽艇到那儿去。(不可用 by)
• Cloth is often measured in meters. 布常用米丈量。
• She became rich through hard work. 她通过辛勤劳动而致富。
• He opened the door with his key. 他用钥匙开了门。
▶ 表示让步的介词:
表示让步的介词有: despite, in spite of, for all, with all 等。
• Despite the bad weather we enjoyed our holiday immensely.
尽管天气不好，我们的假期仍过得非常愉快。
• In spite of great efforts, they failed to carry their plans through.
尽管作出了巨大努力，他们还是没能完成计划。
• For all its merits, the alloy does not measure up to the requirements.
尽管这合金有许多优点，还是不符合要求。
• With all his wealth, he is not happy. 尽管他很有钱，他并不幸福。
▶ 表示原料的介词:
表示原料的介词有：from, of, out of, with, in 等。of 和 out of 表示制成品的材料仍保持原材料的性质；with 表示制成产品的一种成分；from 表示制成品已失去了原材料的性质；in 表示制成品的材料的色调或特性。
• His house was built of bricks. 他的房子是用砖砌成的。
• She made these toys out of old cigar-boxes. 她用旧烟盒做了这些玩具
• A fruitcake is made with fruit. 水果蛋糕是用水果做的。
• This kind of wine is made from grape. 这种酒是用葡萄做的。
• We have furniture of this design in oak and in walnut.
我们有这种设计式样的橡木和胡桃木家具。
▶ 表示状态的介词:
表示状态的介词有：at, in, on, off, under, out of, away from 等，这些介词与名词搭配构成许多介词短语。
• The show is now in progress. 演出正在进行中。
• I will be at ease once leave for vacation.
一旦离开去度假，我会感觉怡然自得。
• He’s at work on a novel. 他正在写一本小说。
• Are you off duty? 你下班了吗?
• I’ll be away on vacation from tomorrow to next Friday.
从明天开始到下周五我要离开去度假了。
• Don’t put yourself in danger. 不要自投险境。
• Twenty firemen were trying to bring the fire under control.
二十名消防队员正在努力控制住火势。
▶ 表示量度的介词:
表示量度的介词有：at, by, for 等。表示价格速度、比率一般用 at; 表示量度的单位、标准、幅度一般用 by; 表示等值用 for。
• Between 1974 and 1997, the number of overseas visitors expanded by 27%.
在 1974 年和 1997 年之间,外国游客数量增加了 27%。
• Eggs are sold at 95 cents dozen here. 这里的鸡蛋每打 95 美分。
• I bought the ticket for five pounds. 我花了五英镑买了那张票。
• He lives in room 5 m by 4 m. 他住在一间长五米宽四米的房间里。

第二十二单元 语法点拨 常用介词的用法（下）
▶ 表示目的、对象的介词：
表示目的、对象的介词有：for, to, at, on, for the purpose of, for the sake of, on behalf of, in honor of, with a view to.
• for 可表示受益对象或预定接收者；to 常表示动作指向或接收者。实际是否收到，应结合整句含义判断，不能只由介词决定。
▪ I brought the gift for my little sister. 我为我的小妹妹带来了礼物。
▪ I gave the gift to my little sister. 我把礼物给了我的小妹妹。
▪ for 和 to 都可引导目的地，搭配随动词和语境而定，如 leave/set out for 与 go/come/fly to。部分动词可与两者搭配，不宜把动词机械分成互斥的两组。
• They have left for Hong Kong. 他们已经离开去香港。
• He flew to America via Hong Kong. 他途经香港去了美国。
▶ 表示条件或例外的介词：
表示条件的结构有 but for、in case of、in the event of、without 等；except for 主要表示例外，见最后一例。
• But for the rain we would have had a nice holiday.
要不是因为下雨，我们的假日一定过得很惬意。
• The doctor asked us not to call him during the night except in case of necessity.
医生吩咐我们，除非必须，否则不要在夜里叫他。
• In the event of rain, the party will be held indoors.
万一下雨，聚会就在室内举行。
• She has enjoyed perfect health, except for an occasional cold.
除了偶尔感冒外，她的健康状况非常好。
▶ 表示结果的介词:
表示结果的介词有：into, to 等。
• Intense cold turns water into ice. 酷冷把水变成了冰。
• The town came to life after sunrise. 日出之后，这个市镇变得充满生气。
▶ 表示对比的介词:
表示对比的介词有: against, beside, to, in comparison with, in contrast to/with 等。
• A majority of 10 against 3 十比三的多数
• The pine trees were black against the morning sky.
在早晨天空的映照下，那些松树呈黑色。
• The score was 9 to 5. 得分是九比五。
• You’re quite tall beside your brother. 与你兄弟相比，你是相当高的。
• In contrast with their system, ours seems very old-fashioned.
我们的制度与他们的相比，显得过于守旧了。
▶ 表示方式、方法、手段的介词:
表示方式、方法和手段的介词有: after, by, in, on, like, through, with, without, by means of 等。after 表示模仿；by 表示途径或手段；in 表示方式；on 表示工具；through 表示途径、手段，与 by 的意义接近；with 表示工具、抽象方式。
• She was named after her grandmother. 她以她祖母的名字为名。
• She makes a living by writing. 她靠写作谋生。
• The boy goes to school by bus. 这男孩乘公共汽车去上学。(不用冠词)
• The quickest means of travel is by plane.
最快的旅行途径是乘飞机。(不用冠词)
• He arrived at the airport in a brand-new car.
他乘坐一辆崭新的小车到达机场。(不可用 by)
• We will go there on a launch. 我们将乘一艘汽艇到那儿去。（on 后这里用 a launch；若概括交通方式，可说 by boat，并非船只一律不能用 by。）
• Cloth is often measured in meters. 布常用米丈量。
• She became rich through hard work. 她通过辛勤劳动而致富。
• He opened the door with his key. 他用钥匙开了门。
▶ 表示让步的介词:
表示让步的介词有: despite, in spite of, for all, with all 等。
• Despite the bad weather we enjoyed our holiday immensely.
尽管天气不好，我们的假期仍过得非常愉快。
• In spite of great efforts, they failed to carry their plans through.
尽管作出了巨大努力，他们还是没能完成计划。
• For all its merits, the alloy does not measure up to the requirements.
尽管这合金有许多优点，还是不符合要求。
• With all his wealth, he is not happy. 尽管他很有钱，他并不幸福。
▶ 表示原料的介词:
表示原料、材料的结构有 from、of、out of、with、in 等。made of 强调构成材料；made from 常用于说明制造来源；made out of 常强调由原物改制；made with 常介绍食品饮料的配料。它们不能只按原材料性质是否改变机械区分。in oak/in walnut 等可说明所用材料。
• His house was built of bricks. 他的房子是用砖砌成的。
• She made these toys out of old cigar-boxes. 她用旧烟盒做了这些玩具。
• A fruitcake is made with fruit. 水果蛋糕是用水果做的。
• This kind of wine is made from grapes. 这种酒是用葡萄做的。
• We have furniture of this design in oak and in walnut.
我们有这种设计式样的橡木和胡桃木家具。
▶ 表示状态的介词:
表示状态的介词有：at, in, on, off, under, out of, away from 等，这些介词与名词搭配构成许多介词短语。
• The show is now in progress. 演出正在进行中。
• I will be at ease once I leave for vacation.
一旦离开去度假，我会感觉怡然自得。
• He’s at work on a novel. 他正在写一本小说。
• Are you off duty? 你下班了吗?
• I’ll be away on vacation from tomorrow to next Friday.
从明天开始到下周五我要离开去度假了。
• Don’t put yourself in danger. 不要自投险境。
• Twenty firemen were trying to bring the fire under control.
二十名消防队员正在努力控制住火势。
▶ 表示量度的介词:
表示量度的介词有：at, by, for 等。表示价格速度、比率一般用 at; 表示量度的单位、标准、幅度一般用 by; 表示等值用 for。
• Between 1974 and 1997, the number of overseas visitors expanded by 27%.
在 1974 年和 1997 年之间,外国游客数量增加了 27%。
• Eggs are sold at 95 cents a dozen here. 这里的鸡蛋每打 95 美分。
• I bought the ticket for five pounds. 我花了五英镑买了那张票。
• He lives in a room 5 m by 4 m. 他住在一间长五米宽四米的房间里。
